function: Jointly learns UAV 3-D trajectory and transmit beamformers of a multi-UAV ISAC system to maximize communication sum rate under a sensing beam-pattern-gain constraint (pp. 5, 8).
system: Three UAVs with 4-antenna ULAs serve six communication and three sensing single-antenna users at 2 GHz, 15 MHz; aerial LoS links, no RIS (pp. 3, 9).
method: Multi-agent reinforcement learning, HR-MAPPO, a hybrid-reward PPO with team and individual actor-critic networks, centralized training with distributed execution; K-means user association (pp. 6-9).
data_channel: Own simulator: LoS free-space path loss with ULA array response, users roaming randomly in a 500 m square; no 3GPP model or measurements (pp. 3, 5, 9).
test_conditions: Training and main tests with 3 UAVs, 9 users; Fig. 6 test episode in a changed configuration, user reassociation added at test but not in training (pp. 9-10).
baselines: Learned: PPO, MAPPO; user association: K-means-based, no reassociation; ground ISAC with fixed base stations also uses HR-MAPPO; no non-learned beamforming or trajectory baseline (pp. 9-12).
metrics: Average reward, sum data rate, beampattern gain pass rate, sum rate versus number of UAVs, users and sensing threshold (pp. 10-12).
complexity: O(K*N + N^2) per iteration for user association and O(4NEK(...)) for the HR-MAPPO networks; 9.8 MFLOPs per episode (pp. 8-9).
q1_support: p. 3: "We consider the free-space path loss model in this article"; custom simulator with ULA array responses, no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured channel.
q2_support: p. 10: "UAV agents are trained without user reassociation, while two user association algorithms are added at a test episode"; the test episode also uses a changed configuration ("reduce one UAV and one set of users").
q3_support: p. 9: "with two other PG-based algorithms, PPO and MAPPO"; learned baselines only, no non-learned beamforming or trajectory method is compared, and the K-means or no-reassociation variants are ablations.
q4_support: p. 9: "the per episode FLOPs of the HR-MAPPO can be calculated as 9.8 MFLOPs"; pp. 8-9 also give O(...) expressions for the association and the networks.
q5_support: p. 9: "This section evaluates the proposed HR-MAPPO algorithm on an UAV-enabled ISAC scenario"; own simulation, no code or data link, no public or measured dataset.
notes: Included, area 6: the learned HR-MAPPO sets UAV trajectory (above PHY) jointly with transmit beamformers (PHY) of an aerial ISAC link; area 6 wins over 5 by the order of the protocol, area 5 if the reviewer sees plain ISAC beamforming. q2 is borderline: it rests only on the Fig. 6 test episode, where agents trained without reassociation are tested with it in a changed configuration; Figs. 8-11 and sweeps are in the training setting. q3 is 0: PPO and MAPPO are learned baselines but no non-learned baseline is compared; convex optimization appears only as motivation. Tables II-III and Figs. 4-11 read as page images.
